scenes.narration: Haea brings sleep, nutrition, activity and biometrics together on your iPhone.
Connect Apple Health for an optional eight a.m. briefing of yesterday's key metrics.
Log workouts, food, water, weight and mood.
Track macros against targets, with seven and thirty day trends for every metric.
Logging and charts are free; Premium is one ninety-nine a month or fourteen ninety-nine a year. Nothing leaves the phone.
In development for 2026. Join the waitlist.

bumper.note: Purplelink LLC brand bumper at start and end; narration never overlaps the bumpers.
